 "data": "@startuml
left to right direction
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam roundcorner 8
skinparam shadowing false
skinparam actorStyle awesome

actor \"Gerente de Vendas\" as GV

rectangle \"Sistema de Gestão e Simulação de Regras (Dom Rock) - Fluxo Operacional\" {
 usecase \"UC01: Inserir Regra por\nLinguagem Natural (Voz/Texto)\" as UC01 #AliceBlue
 usecase \"UC02: Identificar Parâmetros\nFaltantes\" as UC02 #AliceBlue
 usecase \"UC03: Editar Parâmetros\nda Regra\" as UC03 #AliceBlue

 usecase \"UC09: Visualizar Status\nda Regra\" as UC09 #Lavender
 usecase \"UC10: Visualizar/Editar\nPerfil\" as UC10 #Lavender
}

GV -- UC01
GV -- UC02
GV -- UC03
GV -- UC04
GV -- UC05
GV -- UC06
GV -- UC09
GV -- UC10

UC02 .> UC01 : <<extend>>
UC05 .> UC04 : <<extend>>
UC06 .> UC04 : <<include>>

@enduml",
